passed_cases.expectation: Enabled roles submit exact number, target85 and optional instruction; disabled roles are absent.
Count2→1→2 retains hidden settings but submits only current active profiles.
Absent/disabled recurrence omits the field and preserves ordinary mistake counts.
Advanced recurring_errors override the simple fields.
An exact positive count below enabled-speaker count is explained; zero remains supported.
Complete blueprint expansion freezes two explicit profile settings without changing voice/default policies.
Repeated/out-of-range speaker and impossible exact count fail one input admission; zero preserves settings.
Literal20-opportunity cases at70/85/95 yield14/17/19;7at85 yields6;4at85 yields3.
Sixteen of20 marked mutations cannot satisfy85%; no invented denominator or percent.
A different speaker’s otherwise identical words do not enter this profile’s opportunities.
Duplicate/mislocated or unkeyed opportunities do not count as distinct occurrences.
A supposedly correct exception cannot have changed wording or a scoped acoustic operation.
One valid recurring unit with several actual changes passes the existing full mutation admission.
The actual manifest/key projection retains every eligible context, rule and profile through schema admission.
A recurring group with repeated edits is forwarded once per turn for shared variant rendering, without losing any actual operations.
Ordinary speech plans do not acquire a recurring-variant directive.
One general detected/corrected group gives one TP, supported primary score and the actual M/N result reference.
Absent profiles cannot introduce an unsolicited recurring group; explicit zero needs no group.
A false supplied explanation keeps supported primary credit and scores the optional reason separately.
Actual saved synthetic key and positive/negative score summaries pass the complete evaluation and feedback DTO admissions; no inference or storage mutation.
Actual browser changes per-role rule/rate and saved effective request retains those settings.
Disabled/hidden roles and transport failure retain unsaved topic/voices/recurrence without new inference.
Real local synthesis retains one shared same-unit phone variant, three distinct scopes and the saved mutations.
The third of four phonetic opportunities has no edit and its waveform correspondence is retained unchanged.
Declared recurring scopes compile to one combined variant with exact literal phones and shifted phone intervals; correct third occurrence remains unchanged.
Ordinary independent same-unit scopes retain their three separate variants and existing semantics.
Actual included-plan generation persists one group, exact independently observed eligible subset and audio.
A real common-rule answer maps once to the group, with actual scoring and comments.
A real assertion against the saved correct exception is false-positive rather than a group detection.
Original attempt/configuration match baseline and selected resources exclude paid dispatch/fallback.

invalidation_decisions: New recurring owners/DTOs/prompts required the selected new cases and directly affected native/request/acoustic regressions.
Quota-negative initially inspected the safe public error instead of the typed admission detail; that assertion alone was repaired and repeated.
Actual evaluation-key and feedback-score counterexamples invalidated the persistence/score projection assertions and their actual live stages; only those were repaired/retried.
The added summary negative first demanded a redundant range recheck of trusted data; it now checks a wrong-typed field. No repeated runtime range audit was introduced.
The teacher disclosure fixture excludes native evidence_ids, as its existing contract requires; its corrected projection was observed separately.
The two evidence assertion/collector repairs account for explicit frozen null defaults and nested native speech wire receipts; six prior artifact greens were retained.
The web production build and unchanged request/accent/old native leaves retain their original valid receipts. Commit/report/task updates alone do not invalidate behavior.
The saved-projection command adapter was aligned with the existing go-test-json argv contract and executed successfully; the workflow checker was unchanged.
Final schema-copy/vector and DAG gates were rerun after actual contract/selected-case changes. No earlier failure was overwritten or presented as a pass.
proof_boundary: Finite constructed literal admission/arithmetic tests and two actual authored answer probes; no universal LLM accuracy or exhaustive linguistic eligibility claim.
One actual local recurring pronunciation sample on each of Melo and Kokoro; exact scopes and correct-waveform preservation, not a perceptual guarantee for every operation/voice.
No real-person fossilization diagnosis or universal 70-95 percent research estimate.
Self-review of changed owners; no separate external reviewer, unselected provider qualification or renewed whole-release pass.
